classes.name: Sovereign
classes.description: No trust delegation. You own the infrastructure, the models, and the data. No external party can access, process, or observe.

classes.name: Ephemeral
classes.description: Process and forget. Nothing persists beyond the interaction.

classes.name: Trusted Custody
classes.description: Data is held in trust. User-owned, purpose-bound, auto-expiring.

classes.name: Accountable Use
classes.description: Broader use permitted, but every use is visible, auditable, and consented.

classes.name: Bystander-Respecting
classes.description: The people you capture are not your users. Ambient sensing respects those who never opted in.

rules.text: All AI inference runs on infrastructure owned or controlled by the deployer
No network requests are made to external AI APIs for inference or processing
All software dependencies are open-source with inspectable source code
No telemetry, analytics, or crash reporting is sent to third-party services
Network access to the application is restricted to explicitly authorized users via secure channels
Data at rest is encrypted on the deployment infrastructure
The full application stack can be reproduced from source by the deployer
No user content persists in any storage after the interaction completes
No user content is used for model training or fine-tuning
Processing logs, if any, contain no user content — only operational metadata
Caches containing user content are invalidated at the interaction boundary
No embeddings or vector representations of user content are retained
Session identifiers are not linkable across interactions
All stored data has an explicit, declared purpose visible to the user
Data has a defined retention period and is automatically deleted upon expiry
Users can export all their data in a standard, portable format
Users can delete all their data, and deletion is verified complete
No secondary use of data beyond declared purpose without explicit re-consent
Data is not used for model training unless the user explicitly opts in per dataset
Access to user data by staff requires audit-logged justification
Every processing activity is logged in a user-accessible audit trail
Users grant consent per processing purpose, not as a blanket agreement
Users can revoke consent for any specific processing purpose at any time
AI training use of user data is explicitly disclosed and separately consented
Third-party data sharing is individually disclosed with recipient and purpose
Users can view a real-time summary of how their data is currently being used
Active capture of the surrounding environment (camera or microphone) is signaled to bystanders by a clear, perceptible indicator that cannot be disabled or concealed in software
Environmental capture is off by default and requires a deliberate, per-session user action to begin — not a persistent always-on default
Only the minimum capture needed for the invoked function is retained; continuous raw audio/video buffers are discarded once the function completes
Bystanders are not identified — no facial recognition, speaker identification, gait, or other biometric matching against any enrolled or external database
Where any capture is persisted or transmitted off-device, bystander faces and identifying speech are redacted (blurred / muted) on-device before it leaves the device
Data captured about bystanders is never used for model training, profiling, advertising, or any secondary purpose
A documented, low-friction channel exists for a bystander to request deletion of captures containing them, and such requests are honored
Capture is suspended automatically in contexts with a heightened expectation of privacy where the device can detect them (e.g., a paired "do not record" beacon or geofence)
